items.title: 油價居高不下的代價！加拿大央行升息1碼 可能還得再升
items.title_en: The High Cost of Rising Oil Prices! Bank of Canada Raises Rates by One Quarter Point, May Need More
paras: 加拿大央行周三(28日)宣布升息1碼(25個基點)，將基準隔夜利率提高至2.5%，為2023年7月以來首次升息，符合市場預期。央行警告，中東戰事推升能源價格，可能進一步擴散至其他商品與服務，未來仍可能需要升息，但考量經濟與地緣政治的不確定性，將謹慎行事。

防堵能源成本擴散 通膨回歸目標延至2028年

加拿大央行總裁馬克林(Tiff Macklem)表示，通膨展望明顯升高，加上經濟展現韌性，有必要調高利率，降低能源價格上漲演變為全面性通膨的風險。決策委員會認為，通膨風險增加，貨幣政策維持寬鬆的空間已縮小。
加拿大9月通膨率升至3.2%，超出央行1%至3%的目標區間，主要來自能源與相關運輸成本。央行預估，通膨年底將達3.5%，明年多數時間維持約3%，直到2028年中才回到接近2%的目標。
央行同步將2027年平均通膨預測，由7月估計的2%大幅上修至3.1%。馬克林指出，過往經驗與企業調查顯示，未來一年成本轉嫁程度將提高，使能源漲價對通膨的影響更持久。
不過，決策委員會也討論過維持利率不變，理由包括物價壓力仍集中於能源、經濟尚有閒置產能，以及美加關稅爭端可能拖累成長。馬克林強調，未來將逐次會議評估政策，未承諾連續升息。

經濟展望上修 關稅與就業疲弱仍構成風險

加拿大央行將今年經濟成長預測由0.7%上修至1%，並將2027年及2028年預測，由各1.8%提高至2%。聯邦政府推動的生產力投資抵減措施與重大建設，是支撐成長的部分原因。
短期動能仍可能放緩。央行預估，經濟成長年率將從第二季的3.3%，降至第三季的2%，第四季再降至0.8%，反映美國新增關稅的衝擊。馬克林預期，2027年可望隨消費支出延續、出口回升及企業投資增強而恢復動能，逐步吸收閒置產能。
然而，加拿大就業人數已連續兩個月下滑，房市疲弱，移民減少也對部分產業形成壓力。反對升息的經濟學家認為，排除波動項目的核心通膨仍約2%，此時緊縮可能妨礙溫和復甦。
加拿大帝國商業銀行資本市場經濟學家Andrew Grantham預期，核心通膨不會如央行擔憂般加速，政策利率應無須升破2.75%。Servus Credit Union首席經濟學家Charles St-Arnaud則認為，除非經濟轉弱或通膨低於預期，否則12月仍可能再升息。
決策公布後，加幣變動不大，約報1美元兌1.405加幣。加拿大央行下次利率決策訂於12月9日。
paras_en: The Bank of Canada announced on Wednesday (the 28th) that it is raising its policy overnight rate by one quarter point (25 basis points) to 2.5%, its first hike since July 2023 and in line with market expectations. The bank warned that the Middle‑East conflict is pushing up energy prices, which could spill over into other goods and services, and that further rate hikes may be needed, but it will act cautiously given economic and geopolitical uncertainties.

To curb the spread of higher energy costs and bring inflation back to target by 2028, Governor Tiff Macklem said that the inflation outlook has risen sharply and, combined with a resilient economy, makes a rate increase necessary to reduce the risk that rising energy prices turn into broad‑based inflation. The policy committee sees rising inflation risks and a shrinking scope for accommodative policy.

Canada’s September inflation rate rose to 3.2%, above the bank’s 1‑3% target range, driven mainly by energy and related transport costs. The bank projects inflation will reach 3.5% by year‑end and stay around 3% for most of next year, only returning to near‑2% by mid‑2028.

At the same time, the bank lifted its 2027 average inflation forecast from the July estimate of 2% to 3.1%. Macklem noted that past experience and business surveys suggest cost‑pass‑through will increase over the next year, making the impact of energy price hikes on inflation more persistent.

However, the committee also discussed keeping rates unchanged, citing that price pressures remain concentrated in energy, there is still idle capacity in the economy, and the US‑Canada tariff dispute could weigh on growth. Macklem stressed that policy will be assessed at each meeting and no commitment to consecutive hikes has been made.

The bank upgraded its economic outlook, raising this year’s growth forecast from 0.7% to 1% and lifting the 2027 and 2028 forecasts from 1.8% to 2%. Federal productivity‑investment tax credits and major infrastructure projects are cited as part of the growth support.

Short‑term momentum may still slow. The bank expects annualised growth to fall from 3.3% in Q2 to 2% in Q3 and to 0.8% in Q4, reflecting the impact of new US tariffs. Macklem expects momentum to recover in 2027 as consumer spending continues, exports rebound and business investment picks up, gradually absorbing idle capacity.

Nevertheless, Canadian employment has declined for two consecutive months, the housing market is weak, and reduced immigration is pressuring some sectors. Economists opposed to rate hikes argue that core inflation, stripped of volatile items, remains around 2%, and tightening now could hinder a modest recovery.

CIBC capital‑markets economist Andrew Grantham expects core inflation will not accelerate as the bank fears and that the policy rate need not rise above 2.75%. Servus Credit Union chief economist Charles St‑Arnaud believes another hike is still possible in December unless the economy weakens or inflation falls short of expectations.
After the decision, the Canadian dollar moved little, quoted at roughly 1 USD = 1.405 CAD. The Bank of Canada’s next rate decision is scheduled for December 9.

items.title: 巴基斯坦髮夾彎！彭博：改口允許台灣航空公司飛越領空
paras: 知情人士透露，巴基斯坦已恢復台灣航空公司飛越領空權，先前巴基斯坦為支持「一個中國」政策，禁止台灣航空公司飛越領空。
《彭博》取得的日期標注為10月28日的文件顯示，巴基斯坦民航局已批准中華航空和長榮航空於10月28日至隔年3月27日期間使用這個南亞國家的領空。
巴基斯坦國防部長Khawaja Asif 28日稍早接受《彭博》採訪時表示：「航空管理部門奉行『一個中國』政策——只向中國大陸開放，我方只允許中國（大陸）航空公司飛越領空。」
台灣航空公司自上周末開始調整航線。航班追蹤網站Flightradar24的數據顯示，自10月25日上午以來，中華航空和長榮航空的航班均未再飛越巴基斯坦領空。這兩家航空公司至少有12班往返亞洲和歐洲的航班改飛俄羅斯領空。
自2022年2月以來，台灣航空公司與大多數亞洲、歐洲和北美航空公司一樣，一直避免飛越俄羅斯領空。
北京長期以來一直企圖在國際舞台上孤立台灣，但過去從未有任何國家聲明要禁止所有台灣航空公司飛越領空。
新加坡國立大學政治學副教授莊嘉穎（Ian Chong）表示，北京一直要求更多國家對台灣施壓，而巴基斯坦是北京最親密的夥伴之一。
我外交部28日晚間表示，中華民國台灣是主權獨立的國家，與中華人民共和國從不隸屬，這是無法否認的客觀事實與台海現狀。任何意圖透過言論或共同聲明抹黑台灣主權地位的論述，皆無法改變此一不爭事實。
外交部說，將持續與主管機關交通部保持密切聯繫，並尊重台灣民航業者基於飛航安全、飛行時間及成本等考量，進行最佳效益路線之規畫。

items.title: 民生用品又要漲？聯合利華預告明年漲價力道更大
items.title_en: Will Consumer Goods Prices Rise Again? Unilever Forecasts Even Bigger Price Hikes Next Year
paras: 聯合利華(UL-US)周三(28日)公布第三季基本銷售成長5.2%，優於市場預估的4.8%，但北美業務疲弱與食品部門拖累，掩蓋印度等新興市場的強勁表現，倫敦股價盤中一度下跌3.6%，創5月以來最大盤中跌幅。公司並預告，伊朗戰爭推升成本，第四季及明年將加快漲價。

戰爭推升成本 明年漲價力道將加大

聯合利華執行長Fernando Fernandez表示，隨著成本環境逐漸明朗，公司正加快調價，預期2027年價格漲幅將高於2026年平均水準，但仍會兼顧銷量與定價，避免傷害需求。
中東衝突推升原物料、能源與運輸成本，讓消費品業者再度面臨漲價壓力。此前疫情與俄烏戰爭引發的調價，已促使部分消費者轉買價格較低的零售商自有品牌，如今企業須在維持利潤與留住顧客之間取得平衡。
聯合利華今年已將部分成本轉嫁給消費者，第三季銷量仍成長2.9%，價格上漲2.3%，但銷量增速較第二季放緩。Fernandez指出，原物料漲價到產品調價通常存在時間落差，歐洲零售商議價能力強，也限制公司的調價空間。
北美除了食品業務承壓，Liquid IV等保健產品也面臨零售商折扣促銷及自有品牌競爭。Fernandez預期，北美業務第四季可望恢復成長。

新興市場支撐成長 食品業務仍拖累轉型

聯合利華本季呈現新興與成熟市場兩樣情。成熟市場基本銷售下滑，印度與拉丁美洲的Dove等個人護理產品則加速成長，巴西與印尼也提供支撐。Fernandez表示，新興市場消費者展現韌性，許多地區的經濟基本面優於成熟市場。
相較之下，食品部門整體銷售持平，美國零售環境疲弱，尤其調味品承壓。Hellmann’s美乃滋面臨高階品牌競爭，公司已於本季推出酪梨油配方產品應戰。
Fernandez正簡化產品組合，聚焦家庭與個人護理，並計劃將涵蓋Hellmann’s與Knorr的食品業務分拆，與美國香料商味好美(MKC-US)合併，預計明年完成。不過，聯合利華股東屆時仍將持有合併後食品公司65%股權，味好美承擔的債務與業務前景也引發疑慮。
加拿大皇家銀行分析師James Edwardes Jones指出，聯合利華及其股東仍持有拖累集團表現的食品業務，但整體而言，本季表現仍佳，銷量持續帶動成長。
聯合利華維持2026年銷售與利潤率指引，預估下半年基本銷售成長約5%，並將全年基本銷量成長目標由約3%提高至至少3%，反映新興市場需求對集團的支撐。
paras_en: Unilever (UL-US) reported on Wednesday (the 28th) that third‑quarter underlying sales grew 5.2%, beating the market forecast of 4.8%, but weak North American performance and a drag from the foods division masked strong results in emerging markets such as India. The London‑listed shares fell as much as 3.6% intraday, the biggest drop since May. The company also warned that the war in Iran has pushed up costs and that price increases will accelerate in the fourth quarter and next year.

War‑driven cost pressures will lead to larger price hikes next year.  Unilever CEO Fernando Fernandez said that as the cost environment becomes clearer, the company is speeding up price adjustments and expects price growth in 2027 to exceed the average level of 2026, while still balancing volume and pricing to avoid hurting demand.

The Middle‑East conflict has lifted raw‑material, energy and transportation costs, putting fresh inflationary pressure on consumer‑goods makers.  Earlier price hikes triggered by the pandemic and the Russia‑Ukraine war already pushed some shoppers toward cheaper private‑label brands, and now firms must balance profit preservation with retaining customers.

Unilever has already passed some costs on to consumers this year; third‑quarter volumes still rose 2.9% while prices were up 2.3%, although volume growth slowed versus the second quarter.  Fernandez noted that there is usually a lag between raw‑material price spikes and product price adjustments, and strong bargaining power of European retailers also limits the company’s ability to raise prices.

In North America, besides pressure on the food business, health‑care products such as Liquid IV face retailer discounting and private‑label competition.  Fernandez expects the North American business to return to growth in the fourth quarter.

Emerging markets underpin growth while the foods business continues to weigh on the transformation.  This quarter Unilever showed a split picture: underlying sales fell in mature markets, but personal‑care items like Dove in India and Latin America accelerated, with Brazil and Indonesia also providing support.  Fernandez said consumers in emerging markets are showing resilience and many regions have stronger economic fundamentals than mature markets.

By contrast, the foods division posted flat overall sales, with a weak U.S. retail environment especially hurting the condiments segment.  Hellmann’s mayonnaise faces competition from premium brands, prompting the company to launch an avocado‑oil formula this quarter to fight back.

Fernandez is streamlining the portfolio, focusing on home and personal care, and plans to spin off the foods businesses that include Hellmann’s and Knorr and merge them with U.S. spice maker MKC (MKC‑US), with the transaction expected to close next year.  Unilever shareholders will still own about 65% of the combined foods company, but concerns remain about MKC’s debt and business outlook.

RBC analyst James Edwardes‑Jones said Unilever and its shareholders still own the foods business that drags on group performance, but overall the quarter was solid, with volume continuing to drive growth.

Unilever kept its 2026 sales and margin guidance, forecasting underlying sales growth of roughly 5% in the second half and raising the full‑year underlying volume growth target from about 3% to at least 3%, reflecting the support from emerging‑market demand.

items.title: 溫蒂漢堡要下市了？獲14億美元收購提案 盤中股價飆近17%
items.title_en: Wendy's May Go Private? $1.4 Billion Acquisition Proposal Sends Stock Up Nearly 17%
paras: 由激進投資人佩爾茨(Nelson Peltz)旗下Trian Fund Management領軍的投資團隊，提議以約14億美元收購速食連鎖業者溫蒂漢堡(WEN-US)，並將其私有化。周三(28日)監管文件顯示，收購價為每股現金7.35美元，較周二收盤價溢價約20%，帶動溫蒂盤前股價一度大漲約16%至7.12美元。
截稿前，溫蒂漢堡(WEN-US)盤中股價上漲14.25%，每股暫報7.02美元，稍早一度漲近17%。
收購團隊包括投資公司BlueFive Capital、Sixth Street Partners及餐飲營運商Flynn Group。Flynn經營逾340家溫蒂餐廳，是其美國最大加盟商之一，也是澳洲與紐西蘭的總加盟商。Trian與關係人目前合計持有溫蒂約16.3%股權。
Trian在致溫蒂的信中表示，公司正處於「關鍵時刻」，面臨美國消費者承壓、經濟不確定性、原物料持續通膨，以及速食漢堡市場競爭加劇，需要大筆資金降低槓桿，並推動扭轉營運表現的策略。
這項提案正值溫蒂陷入經營低潮。即使計入周三漲幅，股價過去兩年仍累計下跌65%，同店銷售也已連續六季衰退。精打細算的消費者減少外食，迫使溫蒂與同業加碼折扣促銷，爭取來客。
溫蒂近年執行長頻繁更替，重整方向也隨之變動。前Potbelly執行長Bob Wright於5月接掌公司，8月首次主持財報電話會議時，直指優惠方案定位混亂、門市執行不一致，以及一次性促銷過多等問題。
佩爾茨與溫蒂的淵源可追溯至逾20年前的股東行動。Trian曾於2022年探索收購，後來作罷；今年稍早再傳籌備私有化，但隨後報導指出，該公司對溫蒂營運表現、估值及策略方向仍有疑慮，當時無意立即出價。
佩爾茨2月曾表示，溫蒂股價遭低估，並已接觸潛在融資來源，討論收購或其他重大交易。此次提案最先由《華爾街日報》披露，溫蒂尚未回應置評請求，Trian則不願在申報文件之外進一步評論。
paras_en: A investment team led by activist investor Nelson Peltz’s Trian Fund Management has proposed to acquire fast‑food chain Wendy’s (WEN-US) for about $1.4 billion and take it private. Regulatory filings on Wednesday (the 28th) show an offer of $7.35 in cash per share, roughly a 20% premium to Tuesday’s close, which spurred Wendy’s pre‑market price to jump about 16% to $7.12.
By the time of press, Wendy’s (WEN-US) was up 14.25% in‑session to $7.02 per share, after briefly climbing nearly 17% earlier in the day.

The acquiring group includes BlueFive Capital, Sixth Street Partners and restaurant operator Flynn Group. Flynn runs more than 340 Wendy’s locations, making it one of the chain’s largest U.S. franchisees and the master franchisee for Australia and New Zealand. Trian and its affiliates currently own about 16.3% of Wendy’s.

In a letter to Wendy’s, Trian said the company is at a “critical juncture,” facing pressure on U.S. consumers, economic uncertainty, ongoing raw‑material inflation and intensifying competition in the fast‑food burger market. It needs substantial capital to reduce leverage and to execute a turnaround strategy.

The proposal comes as Wendy’s is in a prolonged slump. Even after Wednesday’s rally, the stock has fallen 65% over the past two years and comparable‑store sales have declined for six consecutive quarters. Cost‑conscious diners are cutting back on eating out, forcing Wendy’s and rivals to deepen discount promotions to attract customers.

Wendy’s has seen frequent CEO changes in recent years, with its strategic direction shifting each time. Former Potbelly CEO Bob Wright took the helm in May, and in August’s first earnings call he pointed to a confusing discount‑program positioning, inconsistent store execution and an over‑reliance on one‑off promotions.

Peltz’s connection to Wendy’s goes back more than two decades of shareholder activism. Trian explored a purchase in 2022 but walked away; earlier this year rumors of a privatization resurfaced, though reports said the firm still had doubts about Wendy’s performance, valuation and strategic direction and was not ready to make an offer.

In February, Peltz said Wendy’s stock was undervalued and that he had reached out to potential financing sources to discuss an acquisition or other material transaction. The proposal was first disclosed by The Wall Street Journal; Wendy’s has not responded to comment requests, and Trian declined to comment further beyond the filing.

items.title: 記憶體漲價潮恐延續至2028年！TrendForce估HBM明年營收破2000億美元
items.title_en: Memory Price Surge May Last Until 2028! TrendForce Projects HBM Revenue to Exceed $200 Billion Next Year
paras: 全球記憶體市場供需失衡情況可能持續擴大，價格上漲周期也有望比市場預期更長。TrendForce專家指出，伺服器需求強勁，加上產能擴張受限，DRAM價格可能一路上漲至2028年上半年；高頻寬記憶體（HBM）則受惠於需求成長與產品升級，預估2027年產業營收將突破2,000億美元。
根據TrendForce於高盛10月27日舉辦的記憶體產業專家線上研討會中提出的預測，2027年HBM混合平均售價（ASP）將年增122%，達到每Gb 3.7美元，帶動產業營收年增逾230%。
同時，記憶體供給短期內難以有效增加，潔淨室空間不足及半導體設備交貨期過長，將持續限制產能擴張。

DRAM漲價周期延長 HBM4占明年產業營收近六成

TrendForce預期，未來數季伺服器需求將持續支撐DRAM價格，即使消費性市場需求疲弱，仍難以抵銷供給受限帶來的漲價壓力，DRAM價格上行趨勢可能延續至2028年上半年。
長期供貨協議（LTA）預計涵蓋2027年DRAM交易量的60%至70%，可能使整體價格漲幅趨於溫和。不過，超出協議約定數量的額外需求，仍可能透過協商以更高價格成交，因此市場整體定價仍偏向上行。
HBM方面，TrendForce預估，2027年混合平均售價將年增122%，達每Gb 3.7美元，帶動產業營收年增逾230%，突破2,000億美元。
不同產品之間的價格差距也將擴大，HBM4高階產品價格可能超過每Gb 5美元，較低階產品則接近3美元。
在產品規格方面，8層堆疊HBM4由於單位記憶體基礎晶片成本較高，預計每位元價格將較12層堆疊產品高出5%至10%；下一代HBM4E的定價則可能大幅高於HBM4。
高盛表示，相關預測與該行看法大致一致，目前預估主要供應商2027年HBM平均售價將年增100%至160%。
TrendForce另指出，HBM4受惠於較高的價格溢價，預計將占2027年HBM產業營收近60%。

潔淨室與設備交期成擴產瓶頸 2028年前供給難顯著增加

儘管記憶體大廠積極規劃資本支出，TrendForce認為，潔淨室空間不足與半導體設備交貨期過長，將限制產能擴張，使2028年前難以出現顯著的DRAM有效供給增量。
TrendForce預估，南韓兩家主要記憶體廠商2027年各自每月可增加8萬至10萬片晶圓產能。不過，三星電子(005930KS) 新增產能預計大多用於HBM生產，傳統DRAM的位元供給成長則主要仰賴製程升級。
設備供應狀況預計自2027年下半年起逐步改善，但新晶圓廠要到2028年才會對整體供給產生實質貢獻。此外，記憶體廠商也可能根據市場需求前景，主動調整擴產速度。
在需求端，Google(GOOGL-US) 正成為HBM市場的重要成長動能。隨著Google持續提高張量處理器（TPU）在資料中心的部署比例，TrendForce預期，2027年HBM3E的位元需求仍將獲得支撐，顯示市場需求不會完全集中於HBM4及HBM4E等新一代產品。
在個股方面，高盛重申對三星電子普通股及優先股的買入評級，12個月目標價分別為50萬韓元及38萬韓元，估值採用2026至2027年預期企業價值對EBITDA倍數的分類加總法（SOTP）。
高盛也維持SK海力士(000660KS) 買入評級，目標價為350萬韓元，依據2026至2027年平均預期本益比（P/E）9倍進行估值。
paras_en: Global memory market supply‑demand imbalance may continue to widen, and the price‑rise cycle could be longer than the market expects. TrendForce experts say strong server demand combined with constrained capacity expansion could keep DRAM prices rising through the first half of 2028; high‑bandwidth memory (HBM) will benefit from demand growth and product upgrades, with industry revenue projected to break $200 billion in 2027.

TrendForce forecast presented at its online memory industry expert webinar hosted by Goldman Sachs on October 27 predicts the mixed‑average selling price (ASP) of HBM will grow 122% year‑over‑year in 2027, reaching $3.7 per gigabit and driving industry revenue up more than 230% annually.
At the same time, short‑term memory supply will be hard to increase effectively; clean‑room space shortages and long semiconductor equipment lead times will continue to limit capacity expansion.

DRAM price‑rise cycle extends, HBM4 to account for nearly 60% of next year’s industry revenue. TrendForce expects server demand to keep supporting DRAM prices for several quarters; even weak consumer demand will not offset the upward pressure from constrained supply, so DRAM prices could stay on an upward trend through the first half of 2028.

Long‑term supply agreements (LTAs) are expected to cover 60%‑70% of DRAM volume in 2027, which may temper overall price gains. However, demand exceeding the contracted amounts could still be negotiated at higher prices, keeping overall market pricing biased upward.
For HBM, TrendForce estimates the mixed‑average selling price will rise 122% year‑over‑year in 2027 to $3.7 per gigabit, driving industry revenue up more than 230% and surpassing $200 billion.
Price gaps between different HBM products will also widen, with high‑end HBM4 potentially priced above $5 per gigabit, while lower‑end products will be close to $3 per gigabit.

In terms of specifications, 8‑stack HBM4 will have a higher per‑bit cost than 12‑stack products by about 5%‑10% due to higher base‑chip cost; the next‑generation HBM4E is expected to be priced significantly higher than HBM4.
Goldman Sachs says its forecasts are broadly in line with the bank’s view, currently estimating that major suppliers’ average HBM price in 2027 will increase 100%‑160% year‑over‑year.
TrendForce also notes that HBM4, benefiting from a higher price premium, is expected to account for nearly 60% of total HBM industry revenue in 2027.
Clean‑room space and equipment lead‑time bottlenecks limit expansion; before 2028, supply is unlikely to increase markedly despite memory makers’ aggressive capex plans, according to TrendForce.

TrendForce estimates that South Korea’s two leading memory makers can each add 80,000‑100,000 wafers of capacity per month in 2027. Samsung Electronics (005930KS) will allocate most of the new capacity to HBM production, while traditional DRAM bit supply growth will rely mainly on process upgrades.

Equipment supply is expected to improve gradually from the second half of 2027, but new wafer fabs will not make a material contribution to overall supply until 2028. Memory makers may also adjust expansion speed proactively based on market outlook.

On the demand side, Google (GOOGL-US) is becoming a key growth driver for the HBM market. As Google continues to increase the share of tensor processing units (TPU) deployed in data centers, TrendForce expects demand for HBM3E bits to remain supported in 2027, indicating that market demand will not be fully concentrated on next‑gen products such as HBM4 and HBM4E.

Regarding individual stocks, Goldman Sachs reiterates a buy rating on Samsung Electronics common and preferred shares, with 12‑month target prices of 500,000 KRW and 380,000 KRW respectively, using a sum‑of‑the‑parts (SOTP) valuation based on 2026‑2027 projected enterprise value to EBITDA multiples.
Goldman Sachs also maintains a buy rating on SK Hynix (000660KS) with a target price of 3,500,000 KRW, valuing the company based on an average projected 2026‑2027 price‑to‑earnings multiple of 9x.

items.title: 中國基因科技大廠遭封堵！美國指華大系三企業涉及強迫勞動
items.title_en: Major Chinese Gene Technology Firm Blocked! U.S. Says Three BGI Group Companies Involved in Forced Labor
paras: 美國國土安全部周三(28日)將中國華大集團、華大基因(300676-CN)及華大智造(688114-CN)列入《防止維吾爾人強迫勞動法》實體清單，指控三家公司與新疆政府合作，協助對維吾爾族及其他少數民族實施強迫勞動，實質禁止其產品進口美國。
根據公告，三家公司產品將被推定涉及強迫勞動，除非進口商提出證據推翻推定，否則不得入境。這項2021年立法建立的清單目前涵蓋190家實體，迄今沒有企業成功達到舉證標準、恢復產品輸美。
三家公司此前已遭美國其他黑名單限制取得美國技術及承接政府合約，此次進口禁令進一步升高封堵力道，也凸顯美中生命科學競爭日益受到政策介入。
中國去年曾將華大智造的美國對手Illumina(ILMN-US)列入不可靠實體清單，並禁止其基因定序儀進入中國市場，反制美國總統川普加徵關稅。
三家公司未能即時取得回應。華大集團過去表示尊重人權，否認協助監控少數民族；北京也持續否認新疆存在強迫勞動，以及美國與西方國家提出的種族滅絕等指控。
華大基因提供基因定序及醫療診斷相關產品與服務，華大智造則向研究機構、生技公司及醫院銷售定序設備。兩家公司雖積極拓展海外市場，在美國的布局仍受阻。
兩家公司均未單獨揭露美國營收。美洲占華大基因2025年營收不到2%，占華大智造營收約8%。華大智造曾警告地緣政治壓力拖累業務，並於2月以美國政策環境日益嚴峻為由，決定出售美國子公司Complete Genomics。
美中圍繞這項清單的摩擦已持續升溫。美國7月將另一批企業列入清單後，中國曾制裁六家美國實體作為回應。
paras_en: The U.S. Department of Homeland Security on Wednesday (the 28th) added China’s BGI Group, BGI Genomics (300676-CN) and BGI Manufacturing (688114-CN) to the entity list under the Uyghur Forced Labor Prevention Act, accusing the three firms of cooperating with the Xinjiang government to facilitate forced labor of Uyghurs and other minorities, effectively banning their products from entering the United States.

According to the announcement, the products of the three companies will be presumed to involve forced labor; unless importers can provide evidence to rebut the presumption, the goods are prohibited from entry. The list, created by 2021 legislation, now covers 190 entities, and to date no company has met the burden of proof to resume exporting to the U.S.

The three firms have previously been placed on other U.S. blacklists that restrict access to American technology and government contracts; this new import ban further intensifies the blockage and highlights the growing policy‑driven competition in life sciences between the U.S. and China.

China last year added BGI Manufacturing’s U.S. rival Illumina (ILMN-US) to its “unreliable entity” list and barred its sequencing instruments from the Chinese market in retaliation for the tariffs imposed by former President Trump.

The three companies did not respond immediately. BGI Group has previously said it respects human rights and denied assisting in monitoring minorities; Beijing also continues to deny the existence of forced labor in Xinjiang and rejects accusations of genocide raised by the United States and other Western nations.

BGI Genomics provides gene‑sequencing and medical‑diagnostic products and services, while BGI Manufacturing sells sequencing equipment to research institutions, biotech firms and hospitals. Although both are actively expanding overseas, their U.S. operations remain constrained.

Neither company discloses U.S. revenue separately. The Americas account for less than 2% of BGI Genomics’ 2025 revenue and about 8% of BGI Manufacturing’s revenue. BGI Manufacturing warned that geopolitical pressure is weighing on its business and in February decided to sell its U.S. subsidiary Complete Genomics, citing an increasingly harsh U.S. policy environment.
Friction between the U.S. and China over this list has been heating up. After the United States added another batch of firms to the list in July, China responded by sanctioning six U.S. entities.

paras: 美股周三(28日)開盤走高，標普500指數與那斯達克指數雙雙上揚。SK海力士(SKHY-US)亮眼財報提振記憶體與半導體類股，帶動科技股持續領先大盤，那斯達克100指數延續前兩個交易日漲勢。
投資人一方面等待聯準會(Fed)稍晚公布利率決策，另一方面聚焦微軟(MSFT-US)與Alphabet(GOOGL-US)盤後財報，以檢視支撐美股多頭行情的人工智慧(AI)投資熱潮能否延續。儘管油價上漲令債市承壓，美股仍小幅攀升，但大盤波動較前兩個交易日溫和。

美股期指周三小幅走高，投資人等待科技巨頭財報與聯準會(Fed)利率決策。標普500期指上漲0.2%，那斯達克100指數可望連續第三個交易日收高，SK海力士(SKHY-US)亮眼財報帶動AI相關類股走強。
市場對AI支出終將帶來回報的信心回升，資金重新流向科技股，焦點轉向盤後公布財報的微軟(MSFT-US)與Alphabet(GOOGL-US)。Fed則普遍預期將維持利率不變，決策前美債殖利率小幅攀升，美元大致持平。
Vanda Research的Jai Malhi表示，科技股部位清洗已有結束跡象，有助近期反彈。SK海力士財報是好兆頭，但大型雲端業者的資本支出展望仍是關鍵風險，可能讓部分投資人暫時觀望。
Fed上月才一致通過升息，以因應升溫的通膨壓力，若本次按兵不動，主席華許可能須說明政策官員暫不行動的理由。
XTB研究主管Kathleen Brooks警告，周三重大事件密集，Fed會議幾乎淪為次要焦點，但這種心態相當危險，因為市場預期美國利率未來一年可能再升高達75個基點。
歐洲Stoxx 600指數下跌0.2%，油價上揚壓抑景氣循環類股。晶片設備商ASM International調高展望，股價一度漲5%；銀行股在密集財報發布下漲跌互見。
英國財政大臣希利開始發表預算案後，富時100指數收斂跌幅，英國公債走高，英鎊維持小跌。

items.title: 穩懋光學、基建營收Q3營收占比已過半 看好2027年低軌衛星及航太產品發展
paras: 三五族砷化鎵PA廠穩懋(3105-TW)今(28)日下午舉辦法說會，穩懋表示，隨著第三代衛星規格(V3)開始啟動，加上衛星直接連接手機等實際應用持續發展，目前穩懋在低軌衛星、航太及點對點傳輸通訊上等基礎建設營收已超過40%，其中光學、基礎建設營收占比第3季已過半。隨著光通訊發展持續強勁，穩懋對2027年相關非手機產品需求維持正向樂觀看法。
穩懋表示，近年來因地緣政治升級，持續推動中國中低階手機Cellular PA在地的供應鏈自製率上升，今年更因記憶體缺貨推升終端售價上漲，導致全球智慧型手機高階與中低階機種出現此消彼漲之情形，穩懋因聚焦在中高階手機市場具有相對性優勢。
此外，穩懋表示，長期布局無線微波通訊及光電半導體的多元技術，且具量產規模及國際IDM廠的合作實績，在AI應用全面落地以及新世代低軌衛星密集升空的契機下，有助公司結構性轉型。
總管理處總經理陳舜平表示，2025年下半年起，陸續啟動專案性資本支出，以打通瓶頸限制或提高單片產出，在技術進程上，穩懋針對AI Data Center推出涵蓋短中長距的全方位光通訊解決方案，包括VCSEL、CW Laser、EML及InP PIC，並朝200mW至400mW高功率雷射推進。
另穩懋亦突破目前市面主流0.25μm與0.15μm的限制，成功推進至0.1μm GaN HEMT先進製程，搶攻新世代衛星通訊商機。
在低軌衛星業務方面，穩懋隨第3代衛星規格(V3)開始導入，加上未來衛星直接連接手機等應用逐步發展，對明年需求維持樂觀看法；在光通訊產品部分，穩懋在光學接收端的PD產品，今年處於量產初期及產能爬坡階段，預期明年將迎來較明顯出貨，大規模放量時間點將落在2028年。

items.title: 巴基斯坦髮夾彎！彭博：改口允許台灣航空公司飛越領空
paras: 知情人士透露，巴基斯坦已恢復台灣航空公司飛越領空權，先前巴基斯坦為支持「一個中國」政策，禁止台灣航空公司飛越領空。
《彭博》取得的日期標注為10月28日的文件顯示，巴基斯坦民航局已批准中華航空和長榮航空於10月28日至隔年3月27日期間使用這個南亞國家的領空。
巴基斯坦國防部長Khawaja Asif 28日稍早接受《彭博》採訪時表示：「航空管理部門奉行『一個中國』政策——只向中國大陸開放，我方只允許中國（大陸）航空公司飛越領空。」
台灣航空公司自上周末開始調整航線。航班追蹤網站Flightradar24的數據顯示，自10月25日上午以來，中華航空和長榮航空的航班均未再飛越巴基斯坦領空。這兩家航空公司至少有12班往返亞洲和歐洲的航班改飛俄羅斯領空。
自2022年2月以來，台灣航空公司與大多數亞洲、歐洲和北美航空公司一樣，一直避免飛越俄羅斯領空。
北京長期以來一直企圖在國際舞台上孤立台灣，但過去從未有任何國家聲明要禁止所有台灣航空公司飛越領空。
新加坡國立大學政治學副教授莊嘉穎（Ian Chong）表示，北京一直要求更多國家對台灣施壓，而巴基斯坦是北京最親密的夥伴之一。
我外交部28日晚間表示，中華民國台灣是主權獨立的國家，與中華人民共和國從不隸屬，這是無法否認的客觀事實與台海現狀。任何意圖透過言論或共同聲明抹黑台灣主權地位的論述，皆無法改變此一不爭事實。
外交部說，將持續與主管機關交通部保持密切聯繫，並尊重台灣民航業者基於飛航安全、飛行時間及成本等考量，進行最佳效益路線之規畫。

items.title: 穩懋光學、基建營收Q3營收占比已過半 看好2027年低軌衛星及航太產品發展
paras: 三五族砷化鎵PA廠穩懋(3105-TW)今(28)日下午舉辦法說會，穩懋表示，隨著第三代衛星規格(V3)開始啟動，加上衛星直接連接手機等實際應用持續發展，目前穩懋在低軌衛星、航太及點對點傳輸通訊上等基礎建設營收已超過40%，其中光學、基礎建設營收占比第3季已過半。隨著光通訊發展持續強勁，穩懋對2027年相關非手機產品需求維持正向樂觀看法。
穩懋表示，近年來因地緣政治升級，持續推動中國中低階手機Cellular PA在地的供應鏈自製率上升，今年更因記憶體缺貨推升終端售價上漲，導致全球智慧型手機高階與中低階機種出現此消彼漲之情形，穩懋因聚焦在中高階手機市場具有相對性優勢。
此外，穩懋表示，長期布局無線微波通訊及光電半導體的多元技術，且具量產規模及國際IDM廠的合作實績，在AI應用全面落地以及新世代低軌衛星密集升空的契機下，有助公司結構性轉型。
總管理處總經理陳舜平表示，2025年下半年起，陸續啟動專案性資本支出，以打通瓶頸限制或提高單片產出，在技術進程上，穩懋針對AI Data Center推出涵蓋短中長距的全方位光通訊解決方案，包括VCSEL、CW Laser、EML及InP PIC，並朝200mW至400mW高功率雷射推進。
另穩懋亦突破目前市面主流0.25μm與0.15μm的限制，成功推進至0.1μm GaN HEMT先進製程，搶攻新世代衛星通訊商機。
在低軌衛星業務方面，穩懋隨第3代衛星規格(V3)開始導入，加上未來衛星直接連接手機等應用逐步發展，對明年需求維持樂觀看法；在光通訊產品部分，穩懋在光學接收端的PD產品，今年處於量產初期及產能爬坡階段，預期明年將迎來較明顯出貨，大規模放量時間點將落在2028年。

items.title: 台虹財報出爐 前三季稅後純益6.15億元年增79.93% EPS2.33元
items.title_en: Tai Hong Reports Earnings: First Three Quarters After‑Tax Profit NT$6.15 B Up 79.93% YoY, EPS NT$2.33
paras: 由元太科技(8069-TW)入主的FCCL(軟性銅箔基板廠)台虹(8039-TW)今(28)日公布最新財報，2026年第三季稅後純益2.03億元，季減15.75%，年減10.38%，每股純益0.77元，2026年前三季稅後純益6.15億元，年增79.93%，每股純益為2.33元。
台虹2026年第三季營收24.93億元，毛利率22.77%，季減0.36個百分點，年增4.26個百分點，2026年第三季稅後純益2.03億元，季減15.75%，年減10.38%，每股純益0.77元。
台虹科技2026年前三季營收76.05億元，毛利率22.66%，年增3.54個百分點，稅後純益6.15億元，年增79.93%，每股純益2.33元。
台虹今董事會通過與E Ink元太科技(8069-TW)簽訂合作意向書，台虹擬借重元太在電子材料領域深厚的基礎材料開發與製造技術能力，結合自身在電路板材料領域的研發實力與長期產業經驗，強強聯手、優勢互補，共同布局 AI 高速傳輸材料市場。
依據雙方合作意向書架構設定，雙方將共同推動AI高速傳輸材料的技術開發、製程驗證及委託製造等合作事宜。初步規劃由台虹科技提供關鍵材料，於元太科技新竹及觀音廠區進行製程試產與驗證，並視實際合作進展再行進一步評估後續製造服務等相關事宜。
同時，台虹今天並指出，因長期策略規劃及實際營運需要，與大股東長華電材(8070-TW)簽訂銷售代理合約，於台灣地區代理台虹半導體材料。
台虹 FCCL 產品在提供包括手機及消費電子的應用營收占比達 90%，但今年在面對包括 CCL、被動元件、記憶體等供應鏈零組件等缺貨等供應鏈不確定狀況，對全年的營運看法趨於保守，並努力改善產品銷售結構，預期2026全年營收維持在2025年水準。
已完成在泰國投資設廠營運的台虹科技，目前除 FCCL 產品之外，在開發在新產品包括細線路材料、以 PTFE 填料型的高速銅箔基板及針對暫時性接著需求提供雷射接著材料進行開發，目前開發及銷售進度仍符合預期，其中以細線路高階軟板材料銷售最出色，而半導體材料也進一步進入工程驗證新階段。
而完工且建置完備的台虹泰國廠去年占台虹營收不及 10%。公司指出，泰國廠的生產良率及效率已逐步達到應有的水準，將待時機向市場爭取商機。
paras_en: Tai Hong (8039‑TW), a flexible copper foil substrate maker acquired by Yuan Tai Technology (8069‑TW), announced its latest financial results today (28th). For Q3 2026, after‑tax profit was NT$2.03 billion, down 15.75% quarter‑over‑quarter and down 10.38% year‑over‑year, earnings per share NT$0.77. For the first three quarters of 2026, after‑tax profit was NT$6.15 billion, up 79.93% year‑over‑year, earnings per share NT$2.33.

In Q3 2026, Tai Hong recorded revenue of NT$24.93 billion, gross margin 22.77%, down 0.36 percentage points quarter‑over‑quarter and up 4.26 percentage points year‑over‑year. After‑tax profit was NT$2.03 billion, down 15.75% QoQ and down 10.38% YoY, EPS NT$0.77.

For the first three quarters of 2026, Tai Hong’s revenue was NT$76.05 billion, gross margin 22.66%, up 3.54 percentage points year‑over‑year, and after‑tax profit was NT$6.15 billion, up 79.93% YoY, EPS NT$2.33.

Today the board approved a memorandum of understanding with E Ink’s Yuan Tai Technology (8069‑TW). Tai Hong intends to leverage Yuan Tai’s deep expertise in basic material development and manufacturing for electronic materials, combine it with its own R&D strength and long‑standing experience in circuit‑board materials, to jointly enter the AI high‑speed transmission material market.

Under the framework of the MOU, the two parties will jointly promote technology development, process verification and contract manufacturing for AI high‑speed transmission materials. The initial plan is for Tai Hong to supply key materials, with trial production and verification carried out at Yuan Tai’s Hsinchu and Guanyin facilities, and further manufacturing services to be evaluated based on the progress of the cooperation.

At the same time, Tai Hong said that, due to long‑term strategic planning and operational needs, it has signed a sales agency agreement with its major shareholder Changhua Electric Materials (8070‑TW) to act as the exclusive agent for Tai Hong’s semiconductor materials in Taiwan.

Tai Hong’s FCCL products, which serve mobile phones and consumer electronics, account for about 90% of its application revenue. However, this year the company faces supply‑chain uncertainties such as shortages of CCL, passive components and memory chips, leading to a more conservative outlook for the full year. It is working to improve its product sales mix and expects 2026 full‑year revenue to remain at the 2025 level.

Having completed the investment and operation of a plant in Thailand, Tai Hong is now developing new products beyond FCCL, including fine‑line materials, PTFE‑filled high‑speed copper‑foil substrates, and laser‑bonding materials for temporary bonding needs. Development and sales are progressing as expected, with fine‑line high‑end flexible board materials showing the strongest sales, while semiconductor materials have moved into a new engineering verification stage.

The newly built and fully equipped Thai plant contributed less than 10% of Tai Hong’s total revenue last year. The company noted that the plant’s yield and efficiency are gradually reaching target levels and that it will seek market opportunities when the timing is right.

items.title: 台鐵與JR東日本簽署MOU 攜手深化台日鐵道交流共創永續與觀光發展
items.title_en: Taiwan Railways and JR East Sign MOU to Deepen Taiwan-Japan Rail Collaboration for Sustainable and Tourism Development
paras: 台鐵公司今(28)日與日本最大鐵道業者之一的東日本旅客鐵路株式會社(JR東日本)發表合作備忘錄(MOU)，未來雙方將建立長期合作交流機制，合作範圍包括鐵道設施維護與天然災害應變、車站及資產開發活化、台日鐵道觀光推廣、前瞻多元領域等4項，雙方透過技術經驗分享、營運交流及觀光推廣合作，共同提升鐵道安全與服務品質。
JR東日本為日本具代表性的鐵道事業機構，在鐵道營運管理、基礎設施維護、車站開發及觀光行銷等領域擁有豐富經驗與卓越成果。台鐵表示，此次雙方簽署合作備忘錄，不僅象徵台日鐵道合作關係邁向新階段，更展現雙方共同致力於促進鐵道技術交流。
台鐵表示，根據MOU內容，與JR東日本將透過意見交換、技術研討、相互考察及人員訪問等方式，推動以下相關交流：
一、鐵道設施維護與天然災害應變：雙方就軌道、橋梁、邊坡等土木結構物維護管理經驗，以及天然災害預防、監測及應變措施進行交流，共同提升鐵道系統韌性與安全管理能力。
二、車站及資產開發活化：針對車站及周邊土地開發、資產活化利用、商業設施管理與營運等議題，分享實務經驗與成功案例，促進雙方資產經營效益提升。
三、台日鐵道觀光推廣：結合雙方鐵道特色及觀光資源，共同推動台日鐵道旅遊行銷與宣傳活動，吸引更多旅客體驗台灣與日本的鐵道文化及沿線觀光魅力，促進兩地觀光與人文交流。
四、前瞻多元領域合作：持續依據產業發展需求及合作成果，擴展更多元的交流合作領域。
台鐵董事長鄭光遠表示，未來將結合雙方專業資源與經驗，深化技術交流，並積極推動智慧化、安全化及永續化的公司發展方向，提供旅客更安全、便捷與優質的服務體驗，共創互利共榮的新局面。
paras_en: Taiwan Railways Administration (TRA) today (the 28th) announced a memorandum of understanding (MOU) with East Japan Railway Company (JR East), one of Japan's largest rail operators. The two parties will establish a long‑term cooperation and exchange mechanism covering four areas: rail infrastructure maintenance and natural disaster response, station and asset development revitalization, Taiwan‑Japan rail tourism promotion, and forward‑looking multi‑sector collaboration. Through sharing technical experience, operational exchanges, and tourism promotion cooperation, they aim to jointly improve rail safety and service quality.

JR East is a flagship rail enterprise in Japan, possessing extensive experience and outstanding results in rail operations management, infrastructure maintenance, station development, and tourism marketing. TRA said that signing this MOU not only marks a new stage in Taiwan‑Japan rail cooperation but also demonstrates both sides' commitment to advancing rail technology exchange.
TRA stated that, according to the MOU, it will work with JR East through opinion exchanges, technical seminars, mutual inspections, and staff visits to promote the following areas of cooperation:

1. Rail infrastructure maintenance and natural disaster response: Both sides will exchange experiences on the maintenance and management of civil structures such as tracks, bridges, and slopes, as well as on natural disaster prevention, monitoring, and response measures, aiming to enhance the resilience and safety management of their rail systems.

2. Station and asset development revitalization: Topics include station and surrounding land development, asset activation, commercial facility management and operation. Practical experiences and successful case studies will be shared to improve the efficiency of asset management for both parties.

3. Taiwan‑Japan rail tourism promotion: By combining each side's rail characteristics and tourism resources, the two will jointly promote rail travel marketing and publicity activities, attracting more travelers to experience the rail culture and scenic attractions of Taiwan and Japan, thereby fostering tourism and cultural exchange between the two regions.

4. Forward‑looking multi‑sector cooperation: Based on industry development needs and the outcomes of existing collaborations, the partnership will expand into additional diverse areas of exchange and cooperation.

TRA Chairman Cheng Kuang‑yuan said that the future will see the integration of both parties' professional resources and experience to deepen technical exchanges, actively advance smart, safe, and sustainable development directions for the company, and provide passengers with safer, more convenient, and higher‑quality service experiences, creating a mutually beneficial and prosperous new landscape.

items.title: 美光勞資協議爆無效？勞部：一般契約不受3年限制 若不服可循司法途徑
items.title_en: Micron Labor-Management Agreement Deemed Invalid? Labor Ministry: General Contracts Not Subject to 3-Year Limit; Disputes Can Be Resolved Through Courts
paras: 針對桃園市產業總工會今(28)日對台灣美光勞資協議內容提出質疑，勞動部回應，台中美光1021協議屬於一般性契約，並無團體協約法最長3年期限之適用。勞動部強調，工會代表經授權簽訂的一般性協議具民法效力，若成員對效力有疑義可循司法民事途徑解決。同時，職工福利金提撥可納入團體協約，並承諾將會同桃園市政府持續協助桃園美光工會與資方協商，期盼雙方盡早達成共識，讓勞資爭議圓滿落幕。

記憶體大廠美光在台灣設有重要生產基地，近期其勞資協議引發外界高度關注。美光在台中與桃園擴建先進製程廠區，整體員工規模龐大。桃園市產業總工會於28日針對美光勞資協議內容提出多項訴求，聚焦協議效力、和平協議條款內容以及員工福利金提撥等爭議。此次勞資雙方對於協議性質的認知差異，不僅牽動美光內部員工權益，也成為台灣科技業勞資關係的重要觀察指標。針對產總的訴求，勞動部迅速出面說明相關法律規範，期望能化解勞資雙方的歧見。
對於外界關注的協議期限與性質，勞動部依據團體協約法第28條規定指出，團體協約期限最長不得超過3年，但如果公司與工會所簽訂之協議為一般性協議，則無該條文之適用。勞動部進一步說明，關於本次台中美光1021協議，根據勞資雙方及主管機關中科管理局的表示，均認定該協議屬於公司與工會所約定之一般性協議。至於引發討論的和平協議條款內容，勞動部認為這部分屬於雙方約定範疇，應由協議雙方親自對外說明較為適當。
針對工會成員對協議效力可能產生的疑慮，勞動部表示，工會依據章程或會員代表大會議決，授權工會代表與公司協商後所簽訂的一般性協議，在法律性質上屬於民法上的一般性契約。如果工會內部成員對於該協議的效力存有疑義，建議可以循司法民事訴訟途徑進行處理，透過法院來釐清契約的合法性與有效性，以保障勞工自身的權益與相關訴求。

針對員工高度關心的福利金提撥問題，勞動部引用團體協約法第12條，該法條明定團體協約得約定的事項，涵蓋工資、工時、申訴制度、促進勞資合作、獎懲、教育訓練、安全衛生、企業福利、其他關於勞資雙方共同遵守之事項，以及其他經團體協約當事人合意之事項。勞動部強調，勞資雙方如果想要透過團體協商，就涉及員工福利的事項進行討論，包括提高職工福利金之提撥上限或提撥數額等，並約定於團體協約之中，在法理上尚無不可，雙方具有充分的協商與調整空間。
針對未來的協商進度，勞動部表示，目前桃園美光工會與美光公司雙方均同意繼續進行協商並尋求共識。為了促成勞資和諧，勞動部承諾將會同桃園市政府持續提供必要的協助，致力於促進勞資雙方更進一步的協商與溝通。勞動部高度期待勞資雙方能夠秉持誠信原則，儘早達成共識，讓此次勞資爭議順利落幕，共同創造企業與員工雙贏的局面，維持產業鏈的穩定發展。
paras_en: In response to the Taoyuan City Industrial Federation’s questions today (the 28th) about the content of Micron Taiwan’s labor‑management agreement, the Ministry of Labor said the Micron Taichung 1021 agreement is a general contract and is not subject to the three‑year maximum term under the Collective Bargaining Act. The ministry emphasized that a general agreement signed by a union representative with proper authorization has the force of a civil law contract, and if members doubt its validity they may pursue civil litigation. It also noted that employee welfare fund contributions can be included in a collective agreement and pledged to work with the Taoyuan municipal government to continue assisting the Taoyuan Micron union and management in negotiations, hoping both sides reach consensus soon and bring the dispute to a satisfactory close.

Micron, a major memory chip maker, operates a significant production base in Taiwan, and its recent labor‑management agreement has drawn intense public attention. The company is expanding advanced‑process facilities in Taichung and Taoyuan, employing a large workforce. On the 28th, the Taoyuan City Industrial Federation raised multiple demands concerning the agreement’s legal effect, the content of a peace‑clause, and employee welfare fund contributions. The differing views on the nature of the agreement affect not only Micron employees’ rights but also serve as a key indicator of labor‑management relations in Taiwan’s tech sector. The Ministry of Labor quickly stepped in to clarify the relevant legal framework in response to the federation’s concerns, aiming to resolve the parties’ disagreements.

Regarding the public’s focus on the agreement’s term and nature, the Ministry of Labor cited Article 28 of the Collective Bargaining Act, which caps collective agreements at three years, but clarified that this limitation does not apply to general contracts signed between a company and a union. The ministry further explained that, according to both the parties and the supervising body, the Central Taiwan Science Park Administration, the Taichung Micron 1021 agreement is classified as a general contract. As for the debated peace‑clause, the ministry said it falls within the scope of the parties’ private arrangements and should be explained directly by the contracting sides.

Addressing union members’ possible doubts about the agreement’s validity, the Ministry of Labor stated that a general contract signed by a union representative after authorization by the union’s constitution or a members’ assembly is, in legal terms, a standard civil contract. If union members question its legality, they are advised to seek resolution through civil court proceedings, allowing a judge to determine the contract’s legality and enforceability and thereby protect workers’ rights and claims.

On the issue of employee welfare fund contributions, the Ministry of Labor cited Article 12 of the Collective Bargaining Act, which enumerates matters that may be stipulated in a collective agreement, including wages, working hours, grievance procedures, labor‑management cooperation, rewards and penalties, training, occupational safety and health, corporate welfare, and any other mutually agreed items. The ministry stressed that if both sides wish to negotiate welfare matters—such as raising the ceiling or amount of employee welfare fund contributions—these can be incorporated into a collective agreement without legal obstacle, giving both parties ample room for negotiation and adjustment.

Looking ahead to future negotiations, the Ministry of Labor said that both the Taoyuan Micron union and Micron have agreed to continue talks and seek common ground. To foster labor‑management harmony, the ministry pledged to work with the Taoyuan municipal government to provide necessary support, facilitating further dialogue. The ministry expressed strong hope that both parties will act in good faith, reach agreement promptly, and bring the dispute to a smooth conclusion, creating a win‑win situation for the company and its employees and maintaining stability in the industry supply chain.

items.title: 聯亞Q3每股賺6.12元寫單季新高 明年產能續擴增營運優於今年
items.title_en: Lianya Q3 EPS Hits NT$6.12, New Quarterly High; Capacity Expansion Continues Next Year, Operating Performance Beats This Year
paras: 三五族光通訊股王聯亞 (3081-TW) 今 (28) 日舉行線上法說會，並公告 2026 年第三季自結財報。受惠 AI 資料中心 (AI DC) 帶動高速光通訊需求升溫，加上矽光子相關產品出貨持續放大，聯亞第三季營收、毛利率、營益率及獲利同步攀升，單季稅後純益達 6.21 億元，季增 33%、年增 5.28 倍，每股純益 (EPS) 6.12 元，雙雙創下單季新高。
聯亞第三季合併營收達 15.62 億元，季增 28%、年增 183%；毛利率 58.56%，季增約 1.1 個百分點；營益率則達 49%。累計今年前三季營收 36.88 億元，年增 136%；稅後純益 14.07 億元，年增 491%，前三季 EPS 達 13.88 元，獲利較去年同期大幅成長。
展望第四季，聯亞財務長楊吉裕表示，受惠矽光子需求持續旺盛，預期本季營收季增幅度將與去年第四季相當，約為 16%。目前主要客戶已開始下達超過 6 個月的長期訂單，隨著公司合作夥伴持續擴增產能，預期第四季及未來數季矽光子產品出貨量都將持續成長。
針對產能規劃及資本支出展望，楊吉裕指出，目前聯亞 CW Laser（連續波雷射）及上游磷化銦 (InP) 磊晶產品出貨均相當暢旺。其中，CW Laser 已在 800G、1.6T 等規格進入量產，且產品利潤較短波長雷射高出近 50%，是公司具技術優勢的重要產品線。
為因應客戶需求，聯亞日前已與美系大型客戶簽訂長期供貨合約，近期並追加 30 億元資本支出。若加計過去一年累計投入的資本支出，總額已超過 80 億元，資金將主要用於擴充產能。
楊吉裕表示，聯亞目標在 2027 年將產能擴增至目前的 2.5 倍，2028 年再以 2027 年為基礎擴增至 2.5 倍，換言之，未來兩年產能可望較目前提升近 6 倍，以滿足持續增加的客戶需求。
楊吉裕進一步指出，目前公司訂單量仍高於產能，整體供貨處於供不應求狀態，預期隨著明年新產能陸續開出，營運表現將優於今年。
至於持續加碼資本支出的原因，楊吉裕解釋，公司會依客戶需求滾動調整擴產計畫，目前客戶訂單能見度均超過 6 個月，在手訂單金額也已超過今年全年營收規模，因此公司有信心持續投入資金擴產，迎接後續需求成長。
paras_en: Lianya (3081-TW), the leader in optical communications among the 35‑group stocks, held an online earnings conference today (28th) and released its Q3 2026 financial results. Benefiting from AI data center (AI‑DC) driven surge in high‑speed optical communications demand and continued growth in silicon‑photonic product shipments, Lianya saw its revenue, gross margin, operating margin and profit all rise in the quarter, posting a net profit after tax of NT$621 million – up 33% quarter‑over‑quarter and 5.28‑fold year‑over‑year – with earnings per share (EPS) of NT$6.12, both setting new quarterly records.

In Q3, Lianya’s consolidated revenue reached NT$1.562 billion, up 28% quarter‑over‑quarter and 183% year‑over‑year; gross margin was 58.56%, roughly 1.1 percentage points higher than the prior quarter; operating margin hit 49%. For the first three quarters of the year, cumulative revenue was NT$3.688 billion, up 136% YoY; net profit after tax was NT$1.407 billion, up 491% YoY, and EPS for the first three quarters was NT$13.88, a substantial increase from the same period last year.

Looking ahead to Q4, CFO Yang Jiyu said that strong silicon‑photonic demand will likely keep the quarter‑over‑quarter revenue growth at about the same level as Q4 last year, roughly 16%. Major customers have already placed long‑term orders extending beyond six months, and as the company’s partners keep expanding capacity, shipments of silicon‑photonic products are expected to keep rising in Q4 and the subsequent quarters.

Regarding capacity planning and capex outlook, Yang noted that shipments of Lianya’s CW (continuous‑wave) lasers and upstream indium phosphide (InP) epitaxial products are both very robust. The CW lasers have entered mass production in 800 Gb/s and 1.6 Tb/s specifications, and their profit margins are about 50% higher than those of short‑wave lasers, making this a key product line with a technological edge.

To meet customer demand, Lianya recently signed a long‑term supply agreement with a major U.S. client and has added NT$3 billion of capital expenditure. Including the capital spent over the past year, total capex now exceeds NT$8 billion, with the funds primarily earmarked for capacity expansion.

Yang said Lianya aims to increase its capacity to 2.5 times the current level by 2027, and then again to 2.5 times that 2027 level by 2028. In other words, capacity is expected to be nearly six times the present level within two years to satisfy the growing customer demand.

Yang further pointed out that the company’s order backlog still exceeds its current capacity, resulting in a supply‑shortage situation. He expects that as new capacity comes online next year, operating performance will surpass this year’s results.

Regarding the continued increase in capex, Yang explained that the company will adjust its expansion plans in a rolling manner based on customer demand. Current order visibility extends beyond six months, and the value of orders on hand already exceeds the full‑year revenue forecast, giving the company confidence to keep investing in capacity to meet future demand growth.

items.title: 台虹董事會通過與元太合作意向 攜手布局AI高速傳輸材料市場
items.title_en: Tai Hong Board Approves Cooperation Intent with E Ink Yuantai to Jointly Enter AI High-Speed Transmission Materials Market
paras: 軟板材料廠台虹科技(8039-TW)今(28)日宣布，董事會通過與全球電子紙領導廠商E Ink元太科技(8069-TW)簽訂合作意向書，台虹擬借重元太在電子材料領域深厚的基礎材料開發與製造技術能力，結合自身在電路板材料領域的研發實力與長期產業經驗，強強聯手、優勢互補，共同布局 AI 高速傳輸材料市場。
台虹指出，此一雙方合作將可快速回應客戶對高性能材料、量產能力及穩定供應的期待與需求。初步規劃由台虹科技提供關鍵材料，於元太科技新竹及觀音廠區進行製程試產與驗證。

台虹科技董事長陳永恒表示，隨著AI技術快速發展，高頻高速材料的重要性日益提升。台虹科技長期深耕銅箔基板及高階電子材料領域，藉由累積多年的電路板材料專業能力，積極投入PTFE材料的技術與產品開發。台虹看好AI高速傳輸材料市場的發展潛力，將透過結合元太科技在基礎材料開發、表面處理及跨國量產管理方面的豐富經驗，以及台虹科技在高階電路板材料領域的研發實力，發揮雙方技術與製造資源的互補優勢，加速PTFE材料的開發與量產進程，致力於提供滿足客戶需求之高速傳輸材料，強強聯手切入AI高階材料供應鏈，掌握AI產業發展帶來的新契機。
依據雙方合作意向書架構設定，雙方將共同推動AI高速傳輸材料的技術開發、製程驗證及委託製造等合作事宜。初步規劃由台虹科技提供關鍵材料，於元太科技新竹及觀音廠區進行製程試產與驗證，並視實際合作進展再行進一步評估後續製造服務等相關事宜。
台虹指出，本合作意向書仍待元太科技董事會審議，相關商業條件及執行細節，將由董事會授權執行進一步協商，並以最終經核准的正式簽署合約為準。
paras_en: Tai Hong Technology (8039-TW), a flexible circuit material maker, announced today (28th) that its board approved a cooperation intent letter with global e‑paper leader E Ink Yuantai Technology (8069‑TW). Tai Hong plans to leverage Yuantai’s deep expertise in basic electronic material development and manufacturing, combine it with its own R&D strength and long‑term experience in circuit board materials, and jointly target the AI high‑speed transmission material market.

Tai Hong said the partnership will quickly meet customers’ expectations for high‑performance materials, mass‑production capacity and stable supply. Initially, Tai Hong will provide key materials, and pilot production and verification will be carried out at Yuantai’s Hsinchu and Guanyin facilities.

Chairman Chen Yong‑heng of Tai Hong Technology stated that as AI technology rapidly advances, the importance of high‑frequency, high‑speed materials is growing. Tai Hong, which has long focused on copper‑foil substrates and advanced electronic materials, is actively developing PTFE material technology and products based on its accumulated circuit‑board material expertise. He expressed confidence in the market potential of AI high‑speed transmission materials and said that by combining Yuantai’s rich experience in basic material development, surface treatment and multinational mass production management with Tai Hong’s R&D strength in advanced circuit‑board materials, the two companies can complement each other’s technical and manufacturing resources, accelerate PTFE material development and mass production, and provide high‑speed transmission materials that meet customer needs, thereby entering the AI high‑end material supply chain and seizing new opportunities from AI industry growth.

According to the framework of the cooperation intent letter, the parties will jointly promote technology development, process verification and contract manufacturing for AI high‑speed transmission materials. The initial plan is for Tai Hong to supply key materials while Yuantai conducts pilot production and verification at its Hsinchu and Guanyin sites, with further manufacturing services to be evaluated as the collaboration progresses.

Tai Hong noted that the intent letter still requires review by Yuantai’s board, and that commercial terms and execution details will be authorized by the board for further negotiation, with the final approved signed contract taking precedence.

items.title: 油價居高不下的代價！加拿大央行升息1碼 可能還得再升
items.title_en: The High Cost of Rising Oil Prices! Bank of Canada Raises Rates by One Quarter Point, May Need More
paras: 加拿大央行周三(28日)宣布升息1碼(25個基點)，將基準隔夜利率提高至2.5%，為2023年7月以來首次升息，符合市場預期。央行警告，中東戰事推升能源價格，可能進一步擴散至其他商品與服務，未來仍可能需要升息，但考量經濟與地緣政治的不確定性，將謹慎行事。

防堵能源成本擴散 通膨回歸目標延至2028年

加拿大央行總裁馬克林(Tiff Macklem)表示，通膨展望明顯升高，加上經濟展現韌性，有必要調高利率，降低能源價格上漲演變為全面性通膨的風險。決策委員會認為，通膨風險增加，貨幣政策維持寬鬆的空間已縮小。
加拿大9月通膨率升至3.2%，超出央行1%至3%的目標區間，主要來自能源與相關運輸成本。央行預估，通膨年底將達3.5%，明年多數時間維持約3%，直到2028年中才回到接近2%的目標。
央行同步將2027年平均通膨預測，由7月估計的2%大幅上修至3.1%。馬克林指出，過往經驗與企業調查顯示，未來一年成本轉嫁程度將提高，使能源漲價對通膨的影響更持久。
不過，決策委員會也討論過維持利率不變，理由包括物價壓力仍集中於能源、經濟尚有閒置產能，以及美加關稅爭端可能拖累成長。馬克林強調，未來將逐次會議評估政策，未承諾連續升息。

經濟展望上修 關稅與就業疲弱仍構成風險

加拿大央行將今年經濟成長預測由0.7%上修至1%，並將2027年及2028年預測，由各1.8%提高至2%。聯邦政府推動的生產力投資抵減措施與重大建設，是支撐成長的部分原因。
短期動能仍可能放緩。央行預估，經濟成長年率將從第二季的3.3%，降至第三季的2%，第四季再降至0.8%，反映美國新增關稅的衝擊。馬克林預期，2027年可望隨消費支出延續、出口回升及企業投資增強而恢復動能，逐步吸收閒置產能。
然而，加拿大就業人數已連續兩個月下滑，房市疲弱，移民減少也對部分產業形成壓力。反對升息的經濟學家認為，排除波動項目的核心通膨仍約2%，此時緊縮可能妨礙溫和復甦。
加拿大帝國商業銀行資本市場經濟學家Andrew Grantham預期，核心通膨不會如央行擔憂般加速，政策利率應無須升破2.75%。Servus Credit Union首席經濟學家Charles St-Arnaud則認為，除非經濟轉弱或通膨低於預期，否則12月仍可能再升息。
決策公布後，加幣變動不大，約報1美元兌1.405加幣。加拿大央行下次利率決策訂於12月9日。
paras_en: The Bank of Canada announced on Wednesday (the 28th) that it is raising its policy overnight rate by one quarter point (25 basis points) to 2.5%, its first hike since July 2023 and in line with market expectations. The bank warned that the Middle‑East conflict is pushing up energy prices, which could spill over into other goods and services, and that further rate hikes may be needed, but it will act cautiously given economic and geopolitical uncertainties.

To curb the spread of higher energy costs and bring inflation back to target by 2028, Governor Tiff Macklem said that the inflation outlook has risen sharply and, combined with a resilient economy, makes a rate increase necessary to reduce the risk that rising energy prices turn into broad‑based inflation. The policy committee sees rising inflation risks and a shrinking scope for accommodative policy.

Canada’s September inflation rate rose to 3.2%, above the bank’s 1‑3% target range, driven mainly by energy and related transport costs. The bank projects inflation will reach 3.5% by year‑end and stay around 3% for most of next year, only returning to near‑2% by mid‑2028.

At the same time, the bank lifted its 2027 average inflation forecast from the July estimate of 2% to 3.1%. Macklem noted that past experience and business surveys suggest cost‑pass‑through will increase over the next year, making the impact of energy price hikes on inflation more persistent.

However, the committee also discussed keeping rates unchanged, citing that price pressures remain concentrated in energy, there is still idle capacity in the economy, and the US‑Canada tariff dispute could weigh on growth. Macklem stressed that policy will be assessed at each meeting and no commitment to consecutive hikes has been made.

The bank upgraded its economic outlook, raising this year’s growth forecast from 0.7% to 1% and lifting the 2027 and 2028 forecasts from 1.8% to 2%. Federal productivity‑investment tax credits and major infrastructure projects are cited as part of the growth support.

Short‑term momentum may still slow. The bank expects annualised growth to fall from 3.3% in Q2 to 2% in Q3 and to 0.8% in Q4, reflecting the impact of new US tariffs. Macklem expects momentum to recover in 2027 as consumer spending continues, exports rebound and business investment picks up, gradually absorbing idle capacity.

Nevertheless, Canadian employment has declined for two consecutive months, the housing market is weak, and reduced immigration is pressuring some sectors. Economists opposed to rate hikes argue that core inflation, stripped of volatile items, remains around 2%, and tightening now could hinder a modest recovery.

CIBC capital‑markets economist Andrew Grantham expects core inflation will not accelerate as the bank fears and that the policy rate need not rise above 2.75%. Servus Credit Union chief economist Charles St‑Arnaud believes another hike is still possible in December unless the economy weakens or inflation falls short of expectations.
After the decision, the Canadian dollar moved little, quoted at roughly 1 USD = 1.405 CAD. The Bank of Canada’s next rate decision is scheduled for December 9.

items.title: 溫蒂漢堡要下市了？獲14億美元收購提案 盤中股價飆近17%
items.title_en: Wendy's May Go Private? $1.4 Billion Acquisition Proposal Sends Stock Up Nearly 17%
paras: 由激進投資人佩爾茨(Nelson Peltz)旗下Trian Fund Management領軍的投資團隊，提議以約14億美元收購速食連鎖業者溫蒂漢堡(WEN-US)，並將其私有化。周三(28日)監管文件顯示，收購價為每股現金7.35美元，較周二收盤價溢價約20%，帶動溫蒂盤前股價一度大漲約16%至7.12美元。
截稿前，溫蒂漢堡(WEN-US)盤中股價上漲14.25%，每股暫報7.02美元，稍早一度漲近17%。
收購團隊包括投資公司BlueFive Capital、Sixth Street Partners及餐飲營運商Flynn Group。Flynn經營逾340家溫蒂餐廳，是其美國最大加盟商之一，也是澳洲與紐西蘭的總加盟商。Trian與關係人目前合計持有溫蒂約16.3%股權。
Trian在致溫蒂的信中表示，公司正處於「關鍵時刻」，面臨美國消費者承壓、經濟不確定性、原物料持續通膨，以及速食漢堡市場競爭加劇，需要大筆資金降低槓桿，並推動扭轉營運表現的策略。
這項提案正值溫蒂陷入經營低潮。即使計入周三漲幅，股價過去兩年仍累計下跌65%，同店銷售也已連續六季衰退。精打細算的消費者減少外食，迫使溫蒂與同業加碼折扣促銷，爭取來客。
溫蒂近年執行長頻繁更替，重整方向也隨之變動。前Potbelly執行長Bob Wright於5月接掌公司，8月首次主持財報電話會議時，直指優惠方案定位混亂、門市執行不一致，以及一次性促銷過多等問題。
佩爾茨與溫蒂的淵源可追溯至逾20年前的股東行動。Trian曾於2022年探索收購，後來作罷；今年稍早再傳籌備私有化，但隨後報導指出，該公司對溫蒂營運表現、估值及策略方向仍有疑慮，當時無意立即出價。
佩爾茨2月曾表示，溫蒂股價遭低估，並已接觸潛在融資來源，討論收購或其他重大交易。此次提案最先由《華爾街日報》披露，溫蒂尚未回應置評請求，Trian則不願在申報文件之外進一步評論。
paras_en: A investment team led by activist investor Nelson Peltz’s Trian Fund Management has proposed to acquire fast‑food chain Wendy’s (WEN-US) for about $1.4 billion and take it private. Regulatory filings on Wednesday (the 28th) show an offer of $7.35 in cash per share, roughly a 20% premium to Tuesday’s close, which spurred Wendy’s pre‑market price to jump about 16% to $7.12.
By the time of press, Wendy’s (WEN-US) was up 14.25% in‑session to $7.02 per share, after briefly climbing nearly 17% earlier in the day.

The acquiring group includes BlueFive Capital, Sixth Street Partners and restaurant operator Flynn Group. Flynn runs more than 340 Wendy’s locations, making it one of the chain’s largest U.S. franchisees and the master franchisee for Australia and New Zealand. Trian and its affiliates currently own about 16.3% of Wendy’s.

In a letter to Wendy’s, Trian said the company is at a “critical juncture,” facing pressure on U.S. consumers, economic uncertainty, ongoing raw‑material inflation and intensifying competition in the fast‑food burger market. It needs substantial capital to reduce leverage and to execute a turnaround strategy.

The proposal comes as Wendy’s is in a prolonged slump. Even after Wednesday’s rally, the stock has fallen 65% over the past two years and comparable‑store sales have declined for six consecutive quarters. Cost‑conscious diners are cutting back on eating out, forcing Wendy’s and rivals to deepen discount promotions to attract customers.

Wendy’s has seen frequent CEO changes in recent years, with its strategic direction shifting each time. Former Potbelly CEO Bob Wright took the helm in May, and in August’s first earnings call he pointed to a confusing discount‑program positioning, inconsistent store execution and an over‑reliance on one‑off promotions.

Peltz’s connection to Wendy’s goes back more than two decades of shareholder activism. Trian explored a purchase in 2022 but walked away; earlier this year rumors of a privatization resurfaced, though reports said the firm still had doubts about Wendy’s performance, valuation and strategic direction and was not ready to make an offer.

In February, Peltz said Wendy’s stock was undervalued and that he had reached out to potential financing sources to discuss an acquisition or other material transaction. The proposal was first disclosed by The Wall Street Journal; Wendy’s has not responded to comment requests, and Trian declined to comment further beyond the filing.

items.title: 〈美股早盤〉SK海力士財報點火！主要指數開高 市場聚焦Fed決策與科技巨頭財報
paras: 美股周三(28日)開盤走高，標普500指數與那斯達克指數雙雙上揚。SK海力士(SKHY-US)亮眼財報提振記憶體與半導體類股，帶動科技股持續領先大盤，那斯達克100指數延續前兩個交易日漲勢。
投資人一方面等待聯準會(Fed)稍晚公布利率決策，另一方面聚焦微軟(MSFT-US)與Alphabet(GOOGL-US)盤後財報，以檢視支撐美股多頭行情的人工智慧(AI)投資熱潮能否延續。儘管油價上漲令債市承壓，美股仍小幅攀升，但大盤波動較前兩個交易日溫和。
截稿前，道瓊工業指數漲近70點或近0.1%，那斯達克綜合指數漲近60點或近0.2%，標普 500 指數漲近0.2%，費城半導體指數漲近0.7%，台積電ADR漲近0.2%。

items.title: 不只賣自家雲端！Google找上甲骨文 搶輝達AI晶片生意
items.title_en: Not Just Selling Its Own Cloud! Google Turns to Oracle to Challenge Nvidia’s AI Chip Business
paras: Alphabet(GOOGL-US)旗下Google正調整雲端策略，從主打晶片、模型與雲端服務一站購足，轉向透過外部合作夥伴擴大自研人工智慧(AI)晶片銷售，挑戰輝達(NVDA-US)主導的市場。但這項擴張也伴隨利潤率壓力，以及協助AI模型競爭對手壯大的取捨。

TPU走出自家雲端 擴大市場版圖

Alphabet本周二在第三季財報公布前夕宣布，甲骨文(ORCL-US)將提供Google自2013年起開發的張量處理器(TPU)，讓客戶首度能在Google基礎設施之外使用這款晶片。Google第二季已開始向外部資料中心開放TPU，如今進一步拓展合作通路。
這項轉向由Google Cloud執行長庫里安(Thomas Kurian)推動，他曾在甲骨文任職逾20年。分析師預估，Google Cloud第三季營收將年增約90%，較第二季的82%進一步加速，TPU是成長動能之一。
Google第二季雲端營收達250億美元，雖仍落後亞馬遜(AMZN-US)AWS的420億美元與微軟(MSFT-US)Azure的290億美元，卻是三者中成長最快的業者。
市場對TPU銷售預估差距甚大。TD Cowen估計，今年下半年銷售額為94億美元，2027年增至625億美元；富國銀行(WFC-US)則預估第三季約90億美元、明年達990億美元。Alphabet財務長艾許肯納吉(Anat Ashkenazi)先前表示，既有TPU合約收入絕大部分將於2027年認列。

擴張伴隨獲利取捨 同時供應模型勁敵

自研晶片有助Google降低成本。庫里安表示，Google AI伺服器不到兩年即可回本，採用自家晶片的伺服器所需時間約再減半。SemiAnalysis估計，最新Ironwood TPU的持有與營運成本，比輝達GB200伺服器低約44%。
不過，對外銷售可能稀釋獲利能力。TD Cowen估計，TPU銷售營業利益率約20%，低於Google上季整體雲端業務的約35%。
Google最大TPU客戶Anthropic，也是旗下Gemini模型的主要對手。Anthropic去年10月同意使用最多100萬顆TPU，交易規模達數百億美元。CNBC另證實，OpenAI也計劃向Google採購TPU。
協助Google開發TPU的博通(AVGO-US)本周披露，一項由黑石(BX-US)與三家大型銀行支持、規模630億美元的融資安排，將向博通採購TPU及網通設備，再出租給Anthropic五年。William Blair分析師估計，這僅涵蓋Anthropic明年約一半需求。
Anthropic周一提交的上市申請文件指出，公司使用Google、亞馬遜、輝達及超微(AMD-US)晶片，以依不同工作負載選擇性價比與效率最合適的產品，也凸顯AI運算市場正朝多元供應發展。
paras_en: Alphabet (GOOGL-US) subsidiary Google is adjusting its cloud strategy, shifting from a one‑stop offering of chips, models and cloud services to expanding sales of its own AI chips through external partners, challenging Nvidia (NVDA-US)‑dominated market. This expansion comes with margin pressure and a trade‑off between selling chips and bolstering rival AI model providers.

TPU Leaves Google’s Own Cloud to Expand Market Reach
Alphabet announced on Tuesday, just before its Q3 earnings release, that Oracle (ORCL-US) will provide Google’s Tensor Processing Units (TPU), which have been developed since 2013, allowing customers to use the chips outside Google’s infrastructure for the first time. Google opened its TPU to external data centers in Q2 and is now further extending the partnership channel.

The shift is driven by Google Cloud CEO Thomas Kurian, who spent over 20 years at Oracle. Analysts estimate Google Cloud’s Q3 revenue will grow about 90% year‑over‑year, accelerating from the 82% growth in Q2, with TPU as one of the growth drivers.
Google’s cloud revenue in Q2 reached $25 billion, still behind Amazon (AMZN-US) AWS at $42 billion and Microsoft (MSFT-US) Azure at $29 billion, but it is the fastest‑growing among the three.

Market forecasts for TPU sales vary widely. TD Cowen projects H2 sales of $9.4 billion, rising to $62.5 billion by 2027; Wells Fargo (WFC-US) estimates Q3 sales around $9 billion and $99 billion next year. Alphabet CFO Anat Ashkenazi previously said most existing TPU contract revenue will be recognized by 2027.

Expansion brings profit trade‑offs while also supplying rivals. In‑house chips help Google cut costs. Kurian says a Google AI server can pay for itself in under two years, and using its own chips halves that payback time. SemiAnalysis estimates the latest Ironwood TPU’s ownership and operating costs are about 44% lower than Nvidia’s GB200 servers.
However, external sales could dilute profitability. TD Cowen estimates TPU sales operating margin at roughly 20%, below Google’s overall cloud business margin of about 35% last quarter.

Google’s biggest TPU customer, Anthropic, is also a main competitor to its Gemini model. Anthropic agreed in October last year to use up to 1 million TPUs, a deal worth several tens of billions of dollars. CNBC also confirmed OpenAI plans to purchase TPUs from Google.

Broadcom (AVGO-US), which helped develop Google’s TPU, disclosed a $63 billion financing package this week backed by Blackstone (BX-US) and three large banks to purchase TPUs and networking gear from Broadcom and lease them to Anthropic for five years. William Blair analysts estimate this covers roughly half of Anthropic’s demand for next year.

Anthropic’s IPO filing on Monday noted the company uses chips from Google, Amazon, Nvidia and AMD (AMD-US), selecting the most cost‑effective and efficient product for each workload, highlighting the AI compute market’s move toward a diversified supply ecosystem.

items.title: 電網需求強勁！GE Vernova砸90億美元收購高壓電網設備商Trench，今年第三度上修營收展望
items.title_en: Strong Grid Demand! GE Vernova to Spend $9 Billion to Acquire High‑Voltage Grid Equipment Maker Trench, Raises Revenue Outlook for the Third Time This Year
paras: 2026年10月28日（優分析／產業數據中心報導）⸺ 電力設備商GE Vernova(GEV-US)28日宣布，將以90億美元向投資公司Triton Partners收購高壓電網設備商Trench Group，擴大電網零組件產能。同時，公司今年第三度上修全年營收預測，反映資料中心用電、工業電氣化及老舊電網汰換需求持續增加。
GE Vernova將2026年營收預估由455億至465億美元，調高至465億至475億美元。第三季營收126.4億美元，年增27%；調整後息稅折舊攤銷前利益(EBITDA)19.4億美元，高於市場預期的16.8億美元。
接單成長更為強勁，第三季訂單達290億美元，年增逾96%，在手訂單增至1,970億美元。其中，燃氣渦輪機與服務需求帶動電力事業訂單增至去年同期近3倍；電氣化事業營收則年增51%，主要來自變電站解決方案、開關設備及變壓器銷售增加。
此次收購將為GE Vernova增加約50億美元在手訂單，並擴大歐洲、亞洲及北美製造布局。Trench位於美國北卡羅來納州夏洛特的新廠，預計2027年底開始生產765kV超高壓設備，成為公司強化北美電網供應能力的重要據點。
GE Vernova預估，Trench於2028年可創造約19億美元營收，調整後EBITDA利益率約36%。交易價款將由現金與舉債各支應一半，預計2027年底完成交割。
隨著電力公司加快投資，高壓輸電網路與專用設備需求同步增加，GE Vernova透過併購取得產能與訂單，也讓成長布局從發電設備進一步延伸至輸配電。公司另將2026年關稅增加成本的估計，由原先1億至2億美元，下修至低於1億美元。
消息公布後，GE Vernova美股盤前上漲2.8%，報920.50美元。

paras_en: October 28, 2026 (U-Analysis/Industry Data Center reporting) – Power‑equipment maker GE Vernova (GEV‑US) announced on the 28th that it will acquire high‑voltage grid equipment company Trench Group from investment firm Triton Partners for $9 billion, expanding its grid component capacity. At the same time, the company raised its full‑year revenue forecast for the third time this year, reflecting continued growth in data‑center power use, industrial electrification and the replacement of aging grids.

GE Vernova lifted its 2026 revenue estimate from $45.5‑$46.5 billion to $46.5‑$47.5 billion. Third‑quarter revenue came in at $12.64 billion, up 27% year over year, and adjusted EBITDA was $1.94 billion, above the market expectation of $1.68 billion.

Order intake accelerated even more, with Q3 orders reaching $29 billion, a year‑over‑year increase of over 96%, and the backlog swelling to $197 billion. Gas turbine and service demand drove power‑business orders to nearly three times the level a year ago; revenue in the electrification business rose 51% year over year, mainly from higher sales of substation solutions, switchgear and transformers.

The acquisition will add roughly $5 billion of backlog to GE Vernova and expand its manufacturing footprint in Europe, Asia and North America. Trench’s new plant in Charlotte, North Carolina, is slated to start producing 765‑kV ultra‑high‑voltage equipment by the end of 2027, becoming a key hub for strengthening North American grid supply capability.

GE Vernova estimates that Trench can generate about $1.9 billion of revenue in 2028, with an adjusted EBITDA margin of roughly 36%. The purchase price will be funded half in cash and half through debt, with the transaction expected to close by the end of 2027.

As power companies accelerate investments, demand for high‑voltage transmission networks and specialized equipment is rising in tandem. GE Vernova’s acquisition adds capacity and orders, extending its growth strategy from power‑generation equipment into transmission and distribution. The company also revised its estimate of 2026 tariff‑related cost increases, cutting the range from $100‑$200 million to under $100 million.
Following the announcement, GE Vernova’s U.S. shares rose 2.8% in pre‑market trading, reaching $920.50.

items.title: 蘋果HomeView要來了！亞馬遜端出Echo Show 16迎戰 多款新品齊發
items.title_en: Apple HomeView Is Coming! Amazon Launches Echo Show 16 to Compete as Multiple New Products Drop
paras: 亞馬遜(AMZN-US)周三(28日)發表多款以人工智慧(AI)助理Alexa為核心的新裝置，包括升級版Echo智慧音箱、主打臥室使用的智慧鬧鐘Echo Time、Alexa數位相框，以及重新設計的16吋智慧螢幕Echo Show 16。隨著蘋果(AAPL-US)準備推出智慧家庭裝置HomeView，亞馬遜也加快擴充產品陣容，力拚讓Alexa進駐家中每個房間。
這波新品延續亞馬遜今年秋季密集的硬體攻勢。在裝置主管Panos Panay帶領下，公司此前已推出新款Kindle電子書閱讀器、全面改版的平板產品線，以及Ring新款智慧家庭攝影機與該品牌首款門鎖。
多數新品已開賣，Echo Show 16則開放預購，預計12月出貨；可建立居家3D配置圖的Alexa Home Map軟體，也將於今年稍晚推出預覽版。

Echo音箱升級 入門款漲價並強化家庭控制

新款Echo Dot售價由80美元調高至100美元，並加入原本僅限較高階Echo Dot Max與Echo Studio提供的智慧家庭中樞功能。透過原生支援Zigbee、Thread及Matter等通訊協定，使用者可控制數千種相容配件。
即使標準版Dot承接多數智慧家庭功能，音質更好的Echo Dot Max仍會持續販售。Panay表示，Echo Dot系列累計銷量已突破1億台。
新款Echo Studio with Home Camera則首度內建攝影機，售價由前代的220美元提高至250美元，讓Alexa具備視覺辨識能力，可依眼前物品提供更貼近情境的回答。例如，使用者可拿起桌遊盒，請Alexa+解說規則；也能展示麥片包裝，讓助理辨識商品並協助訂購其他口味。
未來幾周，這款音箱還可搭配Fire TV串流裝置進行視訊通話。亞馬遜將繼續販售去年推出、未搭載攝影機的Echo Studio，並表示兩款產品的音訊表現相同，均提供旗下最佳音質。

Echo Time瞄準床頭 以睡眠感測調整喚醒時機

售價200美元的Echo Time沿用Echo Dot的球形外觀，正面加入3.2吋圓形觸控螢幕，將智慧音箱變成可互動的數位時鐘。使用者能切換指針、數字及趣味風格等多種鐘面，但無法顯示個人照片，也沒有其他Echo智慧螢幕提供的行事曆檢視功能。
考量臥室隱私，Echo Time刻意不配置攝影機。Panay表示，臥室對許多人而言是特別私密的空間，因此產品「沒有什麼」，有時也是重要設計細節。
螢幕亮度可降至0.3尼特以下，減少夜間光線干擾。裝置另以超音波訊號偵測呼吸強弱，搭配睡眠感測功能，嘗試在使用者處於淺眠階段時喚醒。亞馬遜表示，喚醒時間可在設定鬧鐘時間附近、10分鐘至1小時的範圍內調整；偏好準時起床者也可使用固定鬧鐘。
睡眠感測須由使用者主動啟用，開啟後會整夜持續監測，但目前不具備偵測打鼾或提醒潛在睡眠呼吸中止症等健康用途。
Echo Time也內建完整智慧家庭中樞功能，可讓智慧燈具在起床時逐漸調亮。螢幕能短暫顯示音樂控制或智慧門鈴通知，幾秒後便會自動返回鐘面。

Alexa數位相框登場 AI挑照片也能留下語音回憶

亞馬遜另推出Alexa Photo Frame，直接挑戰Aura Home等數位相框業者。黑色款售價200美元，採用實木的樺木與胡桃木款則各為230美元。
這款裝置搭載10吋半霧面抗眩光觸控螢幕，可依環境光線自動調整亮度，並同步Amazon Photos中的照片。Prime會員可透過該服務享有免費、無限量照片備份。
相框內建麥克風，使用者可直接要求Alexa顯示特定人物或某段回憶的照片。亞馬遜表示，Alexa會依人物、時間與情境整理影像，優先挑選較佳照片，並排除螢幕截圖等不適合展示的內容。
系統也會尋找照片之間的關聯，例如並排呈現同一個人年幼與長大後的影像。使用者還能為照片附上語音備忘錄，透過觸控播放；若作為禮物，購買者可預先設定照片與語音訊息，讓收禮者完成設定後即可看到與聽到。
針對消費者多將照片存放於蘋果iCloud Photos或Google Photos，Panay表示，Amazon Photos應用程式可備份iPhone或Android手機上的照片，使用者仍能繼續使用原本習慣的照片服務。

Echo Show 16重新設計 迎戰蘋果HomeView

蘋果售價299美元的HomeView預計11月13日上市，亞馬遜則計劃在隔月推出功能更豐富、但價格也更高的Echo Show 16。
這款16吋智慧螢幕標準版售價500美元，採用陽極處理鋁製外框。亞馬遜表示，相較Echo Show 15，新機可視面積增加10%，色彩鮮明度提升至兩倍，外框則薄近40%。重新設計的音響系統內含10個單體，強調即使在吵雜的廚房或客廳，也能清楚聽見聲音。
Echo Show 16另提供570美元的Nanomatte抗眩光螢幕版本，主打在陽光直射或明亮照明下維持顯示清晰度，這也是HomeView目前未提供的選項。
新機搭載1,300萬畫素攝影機，視野為Echo Show系列最廣。升級後的Visual ID功能，可辨識最遠約17英尺、約5.2公尺外的使用者；攝影機也支援夜間模式，方便在黑暗中查看家中狀況。
軟體介面則提供三種可切換的「Screen Styles」，分別以家庭事務管理、智慧家庭控制面板及數位相框為核心。Echo Show 16同時支援Fire TV，並隨附遙控器，方便操作影音娛樂應用程式。

Alexa Home Map將上線 用3D地圖管理家中裝置

除了硬體，亞馬遜也公布互動式Alexa Home Map。使用者可透過智慧型手機掃描各個房間，建立住宅3D配置圖，再從地圖直接操作智慧家庭裝置。
Echo裝置、Ring與Blink攝影機、燈具、門鎖及恆溫器，都會顯示在地圖對應位置。地圖還會以動態視覺效果即時更新；若使用者裝設戶外攝影機，也能看到車輛經過或有人在庭院移動的動畫。
Alexa Home Map預計今年稍晚於多款亞馬遜裝置推出預覽版，進一步整合旗下智慧家庭硬體與控制介面。

paras_en: Amazon (AMZN-US) announced on Wednesday (28th) a range of new devices centered around its AI assistant Alexa, including an upgraded Echo smart speaker, a bedroom‑focused smart alarm clock Echo Time, an Alexa digital photo frame, and a redesigned 16‑inch smart display Echo Show 16. With Apple (AAPL-US) preparing to launch its smart home device HomeView, Amazon is accelerating its product lineup to make Alexa a presence in every room of the home.

These new products continue Amazon’s intensive hardware push this fall. Under the leadership of device chief Panos Panay, the company has previously released a new Kindle e‑reader, a fully redesigned tablet line, and Ring’s new smart home camera and its first door lock.

Most of the new products are already on sale, while the Echo Show 16 is available for pre‑order and is expected to ship in December. The Alexa Home Map software, which can create a 3‑D home layout, will also release a preview version later this year.

Echo speaker upgrade: entry‑level model price hike and enhanced home control. The new Echo Dot is priced at $80, raised to $100, and now includes the smart‑home hub features that were previously only available on the higher‑end Echo Dot Max and Echo Studio. With native support for Zigbee, Thread, and Matter, users can control thousands of compatible accessories.
Even though the standard Dot covers most smart‑home functions, the higher‑quality Echo Dot Max will continue to be sold. Panay said the Echo Dot series has sold over 100 million units in total.

The new Echo Studio with Home Camera is the first to include a built‑in camera, with its price rising from $220 to $250. This gives Alexa visual recognition capabilities, allowing it to provide more context‑aware answers. For example, a user can hold up a board‑game box and ask Alexa to explain the rules, or show a cereal box for the assistant to identify the product and help order a different flavor.

In the coming weeks, this speaker can also be paired with a Fire TV streaming device for video calls. Amazon will continue to sell the last year’s Echo Studio without a camera, stating that both models deliver the same audio performance and offer the best sound quality in the lineup.

Echo Time targets the bedside, using sleep sensing to adjust wake‑up timing. Priced at $200, Echo Time retains the spherical design of the Echo Dot but adds a 3.2‑inch round touch screen on the front, turning the smart speaker into an interactive digital clock. Users can switch between various clock faces—pointer, digital, and whimsical styles—but it cannot display personal photos or provide the calendar view available on other Echo smart displays.

Considering bedroom privacy, Echo Time deliberately omits a camera. Panay said the bedroom is a particularly private space for many people, so the product’s “nothing” can be an important design detail.

The screen brightness can drop below 0.3 nits to reduce nighttime glare. The device also uses ultrasonic signals to detect breathing strength, paired with sleep‑sensing functionality, attempting to wake users during light sleep. Amazon says the wake time can be adjusted within a 10‑minute to one‑hour window around the set alarm, and those who prefer a fixed alarm can still use that option.

Sleep sensing must be manually enabled by the user; once turned on, it monitors continuously throughout the night but currently does not detect snoring or alert users to potential sleep apnea or other health issues.

Echo Time also includes full smart‑home hub functionality, allowing smart lights to gradually brighten when the user wakes. The screen can briefly show music controls or smart doorbell notifications, then automatically return to the clock face after a few seconds.

Alexa Photo Frame launches: AI selects photos and preserves voice memories. Amazon also introduced the Alexa Photo Frame, directly challenging digital photo frame competitors like Aura Home. The black model is priced at $200, while the hardwood versions—maple and walnut—cost $230 each.

This device features a 10‑inch semi‑matte anti‑glare touch screen that automatically adjusts brightness based on ambient light and syncs with Amazon Photos. Prime members can use the service for free, unlimited photo backup.

The frame has a built‑in microphone, allowing users to ask Alexa to display photos of a specific person or a particular memory. Amazon says Alexa will organize images by person, time, and context, prioritizing the best photos and excluding unsuitable content such as screenshots.

The system also looks for relationships between photos, such as displaying a child’s early and later images side by side. Users can attach voice memos to photos, play them via touch, and if purchased as a gift, the buyer can pre‑set photos and voice messages so the recipient sees and hears them upon setup.

Addressing the fact that many consumers store photos in Apple iCloud Photos or Google Photos, Panay said the Amazon Photos app can back up photos from iPhone or Android phones, allowing users to continue using their preferred photo services.

Echo Show 16 redesign to compete with Apple HomeView. Apple’s HomeView, priced at $299, is slated for release on November 13, while Amazon plans to launch the more feature‑rich but pricier Echo Show 16 the following month.

The 16‑inch smart display’s standard version is priced at $500 and features an anodized aluminum frame. Amazon says that compared to the Echo Show 15, the new device increases screen area by 10%, doubles color vibrancy, and reduces the frame thickness by nearly 40%. The redesigned speaker system contains ten drivers, emphasizing clear sound even in noisy kitchens or living rooms.
Echo Show 16 also offers a $570 Nanomatte anti‑glare screen version, which excels at maintaining display clarity under direct sunlight or bright lighting—an option not yet available with HomeView.

The new device is equipped with a 13‑megapixel camera, giving the Echo Show series its widest field of view. The upgraded Visual ID feature can recognize users up to about 17 feet (5.2 meters) away; the camera also supports night mode for monitoring the home in darkness.

The software interface provides three interchangeable “Screen Styles,” focused on household management, smart‑home control panels, and digital photo frames. Echo Show 16 also supports Fire TV and comes with a remote for convenient media and entertainment control.

Alexa Home Map will launch: 3‑D map to manage home devices. In addition to hardware, Amazon also unveiled an interactive Alexa Home Map. Users can scan each room with a smartphone to create a 3‑D home layout and then control smart‑home devices directly from the map.

Echo devices, Ring and Blink cameras, lights, door locks, and thermostats will all appear on the map at their corresponding locations. The map will update in real time with dynamic visual effects; if users install outdoor cameras, they can also see vehicles passing or people moving in the yard animatedly.
Alexa Home Map is expected to release a preview version later this year alongside several Amazon devices, further integrating the company’s smart‑home hardware and control interface.
